stories.title: AFAD'dan Rize, Trabzon ve Giresun açıklaması: 'Sel ve taşkınlar nedeniyle 231 ihbar alındı'

en.title: AFAD statement on Rize, Trabzon and Giresun: '231 reports received due to floods and overflows'
en.summary: Turkey's disaster management agency reported 231 emergency calls in three provinces affected by heavy rainfall, with no casualties or injuries recorded from flooding. Officials urged residents to avoid riverbeds and flood-prone areas.

stories.title: Türkiye'nin 81 ilinde devreye giriyor: Akıllı şehir dönemi başlıyor

en.title: Being implemented in all 81 provinces of Turkey: Smart city era begins
en.summary: Turkey has established a five-year strategic plan covering all 81 provinces for smart city development, including traffic management systems and other urban technologies.

stories.title: Büyükçekmece'de toprak kayması: 1 işçi göçük altında

en.title: Soil collapse in Büyükçekmece: 1 worker buried
en.summary: A soil collapse occurred at a residential construction site in Istanbul's Büyükçekmece district, trapping a worker beneath the debris.

stories.title: Tarih belli oldu: İBB, 250 taksi plakasını ihaleye çıkaracak

en.title: Date confirmed: IBB to auction 250 taxi licenses
en.summary: Istanbul's municipal authority will auction 250 app-based taxi operating rights through a tender scheduled for October 13, with an estimated value of 6.376 million lira plus VAT for 29-year licenses.

stories.title: Erdoğan ABD'ye gidiyor: Cumhurbaşkanlığı'na Cevdet Yılmaz vekalet edecek

en.title: Erdoğan heading to US: Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz to serve as acting president
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan will travel to the United States from September 20-23, 2026, with Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz assuming acting presidential duties during the visit.

stories.title: Manisa'da yolcu otobüsü devrildi: 2'si ağır 18 yaralı

en.title: Passenger bus overturned in Manisa: 18 injured, 2 seriously
en.summary: A passenger bus traveling from Denizli to Balıkesir crashed and overturned in Kırkağaç district, Manisa, resulting in 18 people being injured, including 2 with serious injuries.

stories.title: Ankara’da yeni nesil suç örgütlerine operasyon: 5 kişi tutuklandı

en.title: Operation against new-generation criminal organizations in Ankara: 5 arrested
en.summary: Turkish authorities arrested five suspects linked to a new-generation criminal organization in Ankara, known as the "hat-wearers," who allegedly committed arson and assault with weapons over the past week.

stories.title: Sokak köpeğini av tüfeğiyle yaralayan şüpheli gözaltına alındı

en.title: Suspect arrested for shooting stray dog with hunting rifle
en.summary: A suspect was detained in Samandağ, Hatay, after being identified as responsible for shooting a stray dog with a hunting rifle. Police recovered the weapon and ammunition from the suspect's residence.

en.title: T.C. Istanbul 31st Heavy Penal Court
en.summary: Reference to Turkey's Istanbul 31st Heavy Penal Court.

stories.title: Atatürk’e hakaret eden şüpheli gözaltına alındı

en.title: Suspect arrested for insulting Atatürk
en.summary: A suspect named Serkan S. was detained in Istanbul after allegedly insulting Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. The person was also suspected of drug-related offenses.

stories.title: Ankara merkezli 15 ilde operasyon: 15 kişi tutuklandı

en.title: Operation in 15 provinces centered in Ankara: 15 arrested
en.summary: An operation conducted by MIT and Ankara Police in 15 provinces targeted an alleged FETÖ/PDY structure, resulting in 15 arrests out of 26 detained suspects.

stories.title: Bakan Fidan'dan Suudi Arabistan'a destek: Sözümüzün eriyiz

en.title: Foreign Minister Fidan shows support for Saudi Arabia: We stand by our word
en.summary: Turkey's Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan expressed support for Saudi Arabia, citing serious attacks on its territorial integrity and sovereignty. He stated Turkey honors its alliance agreement and condemned attacks on oil infrastructure near Mecca.

stories.title: Yapay zeka devlerine dava: Gelişimi yavaşlatmak için anlaştıkları öne sürüldü

en.title: Lawsuit against AI giants: Alleged collusion to slow development
en.summary: Four AI service subscribers filed a lawsuit in the US against Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google, alleging they coordinated to slow AI technology development in violation of competition laws. Plaintiffs argue the coordination reduces consumer value from paid AI services.

stories.title: Trump, yapay zeka için yönetici atayacak

en.title: Trump to appoint executive for artificial intelligence
en.summary: US President Donald Trump announced the creation of an artificial intelligence team and the appointment of an AI Czar to maintain the country's leading position in the AI race.

en.title: Salah's night: 4 goals from Trabzonspor against Galatasaray
en.summary: In the sixth week of the Turkish Super League, Trabzonspor defeated Galatasaray 4-0 at home. Mohamed Salah delivered a standout performance with three goals and one assist, leading his team to the decisive victory.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, BM Genel Kurulu için ABD'ye gidecek

en.title: President Erdoğan to Travel to the United States for UN General Assembly
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan will visit the United States from September 20-23 to attend the 81st UN General Assembly general debate, where he is scheduled to address the assembly on September 22.
